analysis.title: GS - Stankard - Vol Views - 20 Nov 2026
key_insights: Goldman's derivatives desk says uncertainty persists, sentiment is impaired and client conversations suggest the path from here looks increasingly binary. Its Panic Index reads ~9/10.
Dealers are short gamma by about $1bn. Some of that rolls off with today's regular expiry, but the desk models dealers staying short vega in this range.
The calendar lightens into Thanksgiving, which leaves technicals, thematics and headlines to drive price action. The implied move through next Friday is 3.00%.

Breadth in yesterday's selloff was the worst YTD: the S&P advance-decline spread of -426 was the lowest this year. The 1m implied vol of the SPX 'avg stock' is ~38v, the 93rd percentile versus the last 10 years.
NVDA is down ~39% since early October. After earnings, cash-desk flow shows continued long-only supply while vol-desk clients buy call spreads and call spread collars to keep exposure.
GIR sees favorable risk/reward in NVDA at current levels despite risks from a management transition and ongoing investigations, and keeps its $220 12-month price target.

Staples trade idea: XLP 15Jan27 85/100 bearish risk reversals cost $1.15, using near-historic-flat put-call skew (3rd percentile over 20 years) to hedge a pullback in staples' recent outperformance. GS PB shows staples among the most net sold sectors MTD, which the desk reads as hedge funds fading the rally.
The SPX implied move for the week was 1.9%, yet the weekly move was realized within a single session twice in the last four days. Short-dated gamma has repriced higher as a result.

VIX spot is ~6v above UX1, the most inverted VIX term structure since April 2025. Clients faded yesterday's move through VIX puts and put 1x2s, such as a VIX 16Dec26 20/18 put spread bought 30k times as a 1x2.
QQQ trade idea: 31Dec26 680/720 call spreads cost $7.40. The desk cites QQQ near oversold (~33 RSI), washed-out positioning and short dealer gamma as the case for a technical snapback.
Light exotics ideas: NVDA/AVGO/INTC 19Feb27 120% worst-of calls for 1.41% (about a 60% discount to the cheapest vanilla) for a correlated AI infrastructure bounce.
Light exotics ideas: a conditional downside variance swap (GSISCVS1) for crash insurance, and an NDX gamma-weighted dispersion structure (GSVIDNG6) to trade winners versus losers.

market_movers.rationale: GIR sees favorable risk/reward after a ~39% drawdown since early October, despite the management transition and ongoing investigations. The 12-month price target stays at $220.

sector_views.rationale: The desk views the latest re-rating as unjustified. GS PB shows staples among the most net sold sectors MTD.

earnings_insights: NVDA is down ~39% since early October, after earnings. Flows after the print show long-only supply on the cash desk and call spread buying on the vol desk.

trade_ideas.description: Buy XLP 15Jan27 85/100 bearish risk reversals for $1.15 (-29d delta, ref 89.86). Alternative one-delta expression: short GSXUSTAP on swap.
trade_ideas.rationale: Put-call skew is near historic flats (3rd percentile vs the last 20 years), so risk reversals are a cheap hedge against a pullback in staples' recent outperformance.

trade_ideas.description: Buy QQQ 31Dec26 680/720 call spreads for $7.40 (21d, ref 637.04).
trade_ideas.rationale: QQQ is nearly oversold (~33 RSI), positioning is washed out and dealers are short gamma, which favors renting broader tech upside for a technical snapback.
A capital-efficient structure (~60% discount to the cheapest vanilla) that keeps upside exposure to a broad revival of the AI infrastructure trade.

trade_ideas.description: Conditional Downvar (GSISCVS1): variance swap on SPX in a corridor (<15d) via a strip of 2M OTM puts in a 25% wide corridor, financed by a strip of narrow put spreads around the corridor barrier (15d). Delta-hedged daily.
trade_ideas.rationale: Buys insurance against a deep crash.

trade_ideas.description: NDX Gamma Weighted Dispersion (GSVIDNG6): sell NDX variance swaps and buy NDX Top 30 single stock variance swaps, replicated via a 10d put to 10d call strip. NDX leg delta-hedged intraday, stock leg at the close.
trade_ideas.rationale: Differentiates winners from losers while staying defensive against intraday down-trends in the index.
